chunks: Enamourment is made for the disbelievers of the life of this world, and they mock those who believe. And those who are righteous will be above them on the Day of Resurrection; and Allah gives provision to whom He wills without measure.
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between the worldly life of disbelievers and the status of the righteous on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Baqarah is often linked to the concept of 'Tajalli al-Dunya' (the manifestation of the world), explaining how the material allure distracts the disbelievers while the 'Muqarrabun' (those brought near) attain superior status through divine grace. It underscores that true sustenance (Rizq) is not merely material but spiritual elevation, granted by God's boundless mercy without strict accounting, a theme central to the belief in the intercession and high rank of the Ahl al-Bayt on the Day of Judgment.
